What is saved?

Your name, email, optional business name, brief, the page you enquired from, a receipt reference and submission time. Please do not submit credentials, customer records, employee information or sensitive documents.

How is it used?

Renzo uses the enquiry to understand your request and follow up. Submitting does not subscribe you to marketing or commit you to a project. A saved receipt is not an email reply or a quote.

Where is it stored, and who can see it?

The enquiry is stored in this website’s WordPress database on HostPapa. Email notifications use Brevo. Renzo Demartini personally monitors hello@worksbetter.ai. A saved receipt confirms website storage; it does not confirm inbox delivery. For direct follow-up, use hello@worksbetter.ai and your reference. Site administration access is restricted to the site owner and any authorised administrators. The public site has no endpoint for listing or reading enquiries. Data residency depends on the hosting and email providers; Australian-only residency is not promised.

Is my idea sent to an AI model?

When you request a live proposal in the workflow-idea tool, your description, selected focus and priority are sent through OpenRouter to an available free AI model to create a workflow proposal. Do not enter confidential records, personal information or credentials. OpenRouter and the selected model provider process the prompt under their own terms and may process data outside Australia. The generated proposal stays in your browser unless you choose to include it in an enquiry. This website does not connect to your business accounts or perform the proposed workflow. The six worked examples use sample rules and calculations. Contact form submissions are saved for human review, not sent to the workflow AI model. Notification delivery is separate from the saved receipt. We also keep daily request counts using a hashed network identifier to limit usage.

Can I correct or delete my enquiry?

Email hello@worksbetter.ai with your reference and the request. Identity may need to be confirmed before changing or removing a record. Contact Renzo if you need to confirm how long your enquiry will be kept.

What about site measurement?

Google Analytics 4 measures visits and general interactions, such as opening examples, starting an enquiry and a confirmed saved submission. The custom interaction events exclude your name, email, business name, description and enquiry brief. A saved-submission event is not evidence of a qualified lead or delivered email. Logged-in users are excluded by the current Analytics configuration; browser settings can prevent measurement. Optional source information you enter in the enquiry form is included in your private brief, not in the custom analytics event.
